note: NECO Geography round 6 (R34 top-up): core of iron and nickel; slanting rays at high latitudes; the June 21 solstice; the ITCZ where air masses meet; the Atlantic source of the wet-season winds; anemometer speed, hygrometer humidity, maximum and minimum thermometers; dew by radiation cooling; the desert's wide daily range; cumulonimbus thunderheads; the lagoon behind its sand spit; the Niger's arcuate delta; tides by moon and sun; spring tides at full and new moon; traction and saltation along the bed; the south's perennial streams; runoff beating infiltration; the artesian well; the river's regime; dam displacement at Kainji; communal tenure; market gardening; quarrying; Yankari in Bauchi; Ikogosi's warm springs; Obudu's cool ranch; cold currents cool coasts; the sedimentary trough; Sokoto's plains; Cross River forest; Onitsha river port; bared soil and erosion; dendritic drainage. Scanned against NECO rounds 1-5, WAEC Geography (all rounds) and the JAMB pool.
